name: Brewery Park Play Area
description: Cardiff Council play area at Brewery Park, Adamsdown, Cardiff, one of the 116 on the council's 2020 list. It was fully refurbished and extended, with new play structures, benches, fencing and safety surfacing, plus a grassed space for informal play.
